transcript: Another day in paradise. Happy birthday, my love. Today is all about you. Look, Alex. It's magnificent. Wow, perfect. I love it. I can't wait to see you behind the wheel. Looks like he's seen some hard times. Take this. Get yourself a warm meal. If you're hungry, come have a meal with us. Thanks, I'm not hungry. Actually, I own this showroom. I was testing my customers. Huh? Not everyone remembers kindness when they have wealth, but you two do. What? Are you serious? For your kindness, this car is my gift to you. This is unbelievable. This was the best birthday ever.
